default.description: What the app's ordinary windows may reach. Commands declared by this crate are not permission-gated; everything here is either a Tauri core capability or a plugin the frontend calls directly. The overlay is excluded and gets its own, far narrower set.

overlay.description: The recording overlay, which is on screen more than anything else and renders no user content. It only listens for overlay:state / overlay:elapsed and calls overlay_action, and commands declared by this crate are not permission-gated — so this is everything it needs.
